title: Leveraging the Fragment Molecular Orbital and MM-GBSA Methods in Virtual Screening for the Discovery of Novel Non-Covalent Inhibitors Targeting the TEAD Lipid Binding Pocket.
authors: Kim, Jongwan; Jin, Haiyan; Kim, Jinhyuk; Cho, Seon Yeon; Moon, Sungho; Wang, Jianmin; Mao, Jiashun; No, Kyoung Tai
one_liner_zh: 该文用FMO、MD和MM-GBSA等物理模拟方法筛选靶向TEAD脂质结合口袋的非共价抑制剂，虽涉及转录因子TEAD但聚焦小分子药物发现而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移但对象偏离核心。
abstract: The Hippo pathway controls organ size and homeostasis and is linked to numerous diseases, including cancer. The transcriptional enhanced associate domain (TEAD) family of transcription factors acts as a receptor for downstream effectors, namely yes-associated protein (YAP) and transcriptional co-activator with PDZ-binding motif (TAZ), which binds to various transcription factors and is essential for stimulated gene transcription. YAP/TAZ-TEAD facilitates the upregulation of multiple genes involved in evolutionary cell proliferation and survival. TEAD1-4 overexpression has been observed in different cancers in various tissues, making TEAD an attractive target for drug development. The central drug-accessible pocket of TEAD is crucial because it undergoes a post-translational modification called auto-palmitoylation. Crystal structures of the C-terminal TEAD complex with small molecules are available in the Protein Data Bank, aiding structure-based drug design. In this study, we utilized the fragment molecular orbital (FMO) method, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, shape-based screening, and molecular mechanics-generalized Born surface area (MM-GBSA) calculations for virtual screening, and we identified a novel non-covalent inhibitor-BC-001-with IC(50) = 3.7 muM in a reporter assay. Subsequently, we optimized several analogs of BC-001 and found that the optimized compound BC-011 exhibited an IC(50) of 72.43 nM. These findings can be used to design effective TEAD modulators with anticancer therapeutic implications.
abstract_zh: Hippo通路控制器官大小和稳态，并与多种疾病（包括癌症）相关。转录增强关联域（TEAD）转录因子家族作为下游效应子的受体，即yes-associated protein (YAP) 和具有PDZ结合基序的转录共激活因子 (TAZ)，它们与多种转录因子结合，对刺激基因转录至关重要。YAP/TAZ-TEAD促进涉及进化性细胞增殖和存活的多个基因上调。在不同组织的多种癌症中观察到TEAD1-4过表达，使TEAD成为药物开发的有吸引力的靶点。TEAD的中心药物可及口袋至关重要，因为它经历一种称为自动棕榈酰化的翻译后修饰。C端TEAD与小分子复合物的晶体结构可在蛋白质数据银行中获得，有助于基于结构的药物设计。在本研究中，我们利用片段分子轨道（FMO）方法、分子动力学（MD）模拟、基于形状的筛选和分子力学-广义Born表面积（MM-GBSA）计算进行虚拟筛选，并在报告基因实验中鉴定出一种新型非共价抑制剂BC-001，其IC(50) = 3.7 μM。随后，我们优化了BC-001的几种类似物，发现优化化合物BC-011的IC(50)为72.43 nM。这些发现可用于设计具有抗癌治疗意义的有效TEAD调节剂。
